title: Decision
description: One decision (De): a question settled, by the commander or by the pilot, so it is not reopened each session. Filed by identifier, De001.json.

kind.description: the word decision, which is what chooses this schema

id.description: this decision's identifier, De and three digits, the same identifier the file is named for

date.description: the day it was settled, YYYY-MM-DD

subject.description: the question, in a few words

decision.description: what was settled, stated so it can be applied without reading anything else

by.description: who settled it: the commander or the pilot

request.description: the request this decision answers, Rq and three digits; absent when the decision arose on its own

superseded_by.description: the identifier of the later decision that overrides this one; absent while it stands
